articles.title: European football: Lamine Yamal’s double powers Barcelona to rout of Valencia
articles.summary: Fermín, Raphinha and Pedri also score in 5-0 La Liga win. Goalkeeper Koeman Jr scores two penalties in Eredivisie. Lamine Yamal struck twice for Barcelona as they demolished Valencia 5-0 on Sunday to maintain their 100% start in La Liga.
body: The reigning champions moved three points clear at the top of La Liga after Jose Mourinho’s Real Madrid lost 1-0 at Real Betis on Friday. Fermín López, Raphinha and Pedri were also on target for Hansi Flick’s swaggering visitors on a hot afternoon on Spain’s east coast.
Barcelona, the only team in the top flight to win their first four games, took control from the start to the upset of Valencia’s fans at a persistently bad-tempered Mestalla stadium.

“We played a fantastic game, it was nearly perfect, we controlled, we were dominant and this is what I want from the team,” said Flick. “We stay calm and then if it’s possible to score we try to do it – it was a fantastic game for us. Nothing is perfect, you always can improve. If it’s perfect then you can stop working.”

articles.title: Richard Hughes confirmed as Al-Hilal sporting director after Liverpool departure
articles.summary: Hughes joins Saudi exodus after two years at Anfield. Martinelli, Summerville and Watkins are at Al-Hilal. Richard Hughes has been appointed as the sporting director ⁠of Al-Hilal, the Saudi Pro League club confirmed on ⁠Sunday, following ⁠his ​ departure from Liverpool.
body: Hughes, 47, joined Liverpool in 2024 from Bournemouth. ⁠He appointed Arne Slot as Jürgen Klopp’s successor as head coach, ⁠a decision that paid immediate dividends ​as the Reds ‌claimed the ‌Premier League title in 2024-25. Slot ‌was sacked and replaced by Andoni Iraola in June.

“The appointment of Hughes came as part of Al-Hilal’s efforts to strengthen its football system ‌and develop its sporting structure with specialised expertise,” the Saudi Pro League leaders ​said in a statement.

The appointment highlights Al-Hilal’s drive to tap into English football, with Hughes the latest ⁠former Premier League figure to join ​the ​Riyadh-based club. Hughes follows players Gabriel ​Martinelli, Crysencio Summerville and ​ Ollie Watkins, ‌who joined ​the ​Saudi club this summer from Arsenal, West Ham United and Aston Villa, respectively. Al-Hilal’s manager is Simone Inzaghi, formerly of Inter.

Two members of Liverpool’s recruitment department are set to follow Hughes to Al Hilal. Mark Burchill and Craig McKee, who joined Liverpool from Bournemouth with Hughes two years ago, are now poised to team up with the Scot in Saudi.

articles.title: Wild opening salvo against Chelsea hints at exciting times for Arsenal fans | Barney Ronay
articles.summary: The home side’s response to Chelsea’s early goal was to play breathless attacking football. We’re back, baby. So, so back. Well, OK, not exactly back. But back down the time tunnel, for a while at least, as on a powder blue afternoon at the Emirates Stadium, Arsenal and Chelsea produced an opening…
body: In that period this really did feel like a twist on a classic: spells of midfield murder-ball, stretched and flustered full‑backs, players hurling themselves at the defensive lines like the fall guys in a cowboy western being tossed out through the saloon-bar doors.

Arsenal had 10 shots in that period and played breathless, physically overwhelming attacking football. The game settled after they scored their equaliser. In the second half it became simply gripping and episodic, broken up by subs and stoppages, which is the current dynamic. Second halves: these are a problem. But Arsenal never really looked like losing their 2-1 lead.
The key to the day was that agreeably wild opening half‑hour, evidence that both teams have will and the energy to progress this season. Which will, in turn, be good news for the Premier League.

About last season. It was OK, wasn’t it? Quite a lot of demo-mode football. Games that were like watching someone knitting a scarf. Teams with such elite levels of defensive organisation the experience is like watching one of those police motorbike display teams doing a pyramid, while a group of men on laptops furiously study the data.

articles.title: Scottish Premiership: Celtic’s Yang completes fightback to see off St Mirren
articles.summary: Rangers beat Motherwell 1-0 but lose Shankland to injury. Kerjota’s late winner sees Hearts edge past Dundee. Yang Hyun-jun scored the winner as Celtic came from behind to beat an impressive St Mirren side 2-1.
body: Liam Scales conceded the penalty with a handball but made amends when he headed home six minutes after the break. And Yang finished off a counterattack midway through the second half after good pressing from Camilo Durán.

The victory in Paisley made it five wins from five league games for the champions and inflicted St Mirren’s first Premiership defeat. Martin O’Neill’s side were made to work all the way by a Saints side who played with tempo, invention and managed 19 shots at goal.

O’Neill later lamented the unavailability of Yang for some crucial games – the 24-year-old will now fly to Japan for the Asian Games and miss the midweek trip to St Johnstone and two games against Rangers, plus the Europa League opener against Ferencvaros.

“We are going to miss him. He’s in really fine form at the moment,” the manager said. “But he’s signed off with a brilliant goal. He’s in great form and he’ll work for you going backwards. He doesn’t mind doing the hard graft.”

articles.title: No new striker, no worries - Havertz and Odegaard torment Chelsea
articles.summary: Nine points from three games, one goal conceded and big players stepping up - are Arsenal still ahead of the rest in the race for the Premier League title?
body: Arsenal shelled out close to £200m on new signings during the summer transfer window but fell short of landing the elite forward they craved.

Former Manchester City goalscorer Julian Alvarez was on their radar but remains at Atletico Madrid, while the Gunners were also interested in Aston Villa 's Morgan Rogers, Paris St-Germain's Bradley Barcola and Vinicius Jr.
While Rogers opted for London rivals Chelsea, Barcola moved to Liverpool and Vinicius Jr has stayed at Real Madrid.
Yet reigning champions Arsenal have started this season as strongly as they finished 2025-26, when they celebrated their first Premier League title for 22 years.

articles.title: GB&I make history with first Walker Cup since 2015
articles.summary: Great Britain and Ireland produce the biggest comeback in Walker Cup history to defeat the United States and lift the trophy for the first time since 2015.
body: At Lahinch in Ireland, the USA looked to be on the brink when they swept the morning foursomes to move just three-and-a-half points away from a sixth consecutive victory.
But GB&I picked up seven of the 10 points in the singles to clinch victory by 13-and-a-half points to 12-and-a-half and win for the first time in 11 years.

Josh Hill had the winning moment as he defeated world number two Tyler Watts on the final hole of the eighth pairing, and that sparked wild celebrations to mark a victory that seemed so unlikely after Sunday morning.
For Irish player Stuart Grehan, winning the biennial amateur tournament on home turf meant event more.

articles.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks shortstop Geraldo Perdomo left a Sunday, Sept. 6 game against the Houston Astros when he was hit by a teammate's line drive while on the basepaths. Perdomo singled in the top of the third inning, and the next batter, Ketel Marte, hit an 93 mph line drive.
body: He was ruled out because he was hit by a batted ball. Nolan Arenado hit a two-run home run in the inning to give Arizona a 3-1 lead.
Perdomo was replaced at shortstop by Ildemaro Vargas, and Tim Tawa took Vargas' spot at first base.
The Diamondbacks announced Sunday that Perdomo suffered a head contusion on the play.
"He will continue to be monitored today and into tomorrow," the team said.

articles.title: Cubs' Pete Crow-Armstrong hits 40th home run to boost NL MVP case
articles.summary: In just a few weeks, Pete Crow-Armstrong is expected to join Ernie Banks in a select group: Chicago Cubs players who have won National League Most Valuable Player honors. Yet PCA has already one-upped Mr. Cub in one category.
body: Crow-Armstrong became the youngest player in franchise history to hit 40 home runs, reaching the honor on Sunday, Sept. 6 with a low line drive just inside the right field foul pole at loanDepot Park, a game-tying fifth-inning shot off Miami Marlins right-hander Tyler Phillips.
While the Cubs would go on to lose the game 10-3, there's little to stop the Summer of PCA.

He's now second in the major leagues with 40 homers, trailing only Philadelphia DH Kyle Schwarber's 42, and his 8.6 WAR leads all position players. At 24 years, 165 days old, Crow-Armstrong is 49 days younger than Banks was when the Hall of Famer hit his 40th home run in 1955, the first of his eight consecutive All-Star seasons.
Banks would win NL MVP honors in 1958 - hitting a career-best and major league-high 47 homers - and 1959. He's one of 11 Cubs players to win the award.

articles.title: 'Just unheard of! - Antonelli's miracle win likened to 'walking on water'
articles.summary: On a Monza weekend that had already produced one implausible result in qualifying, Italy's new young star Kimi Antonelli delivered a second in Sunday's thrilling race to ensure its own prominent place in Formula 1's history books.
body: Of course, unlike surprise pole position sitter Pierre Gasly - who had never previously qualified at the head of an F1 grid in 190 appearances spent in mostly midfield cars - the 20-year-old Antonelli has become a fixture at the head of the field this year.

Sunday represented the seventh race win of the Mercedes driver's increasingly-impressive second of Formula 1 and one which extended what stood as a 59-point championship lead to a joint season-high 66 points.

But by winning from the second-lowest grid position in F1's 76-year history - 19th place - and beating a team-mate and chief title rival in George Russell who had started from the front row, Antonelli ensured it was anything but just another win.
And that's before you even consider the local factor too - Antonelli ended a 60-year wait for an Italian to win their home Grand Prix again.

articles.title: Rather than a display of dominance, Team USA survived for a disgusting three-point win over Italy at the World Cup
articles.summary: Well, Team USA had tons of trouble with Italy. Less than six months ago, Team USA defeated Italy by 34 points in the World Cup Qualifying Tournament in San Juan, Puerto Rico. On Sunday in Berlin, Germany, Team USA squeaked out a three-point win, 55-52.
body: On paper, the Italians may not have had any advantages over the United States. The resumes and statistics that convey the Americans’ superiority, however, failed to account for the firey and feisty motivation that the Italians brought to the matchup.

Team USA shot 29 percent from the field, with Italy managing a 31-percent shooting performance. Team USA made a single 3-pointer; Italy hit just three. Team USA also missed eight free throws, making their most reliable source of points not all that reliable.

Early on, the Americans were forcing things, with players seeming to want to get their buckets over playing team basketball. As the contest remained tight deep into the second half, American players then became too unassertive, appearing afraid to make a mistake or miss a key shot.

Breanna Stewart, in particular, was unable to buy a basket, missing shots that should be automatic for Team USA’s most experienced player. A late fourth-quarter field goal, finally, dropped for Stewie, giving her a 1-for-9 shooting line and five total points.
points: Well, Team USA had tons of trouble with Italy.
Less than six months ago, Team USA defeated Italy by 34 points in the World Cup Qualifying Tournament in San Juan, Puerto Rico.

articles.title: Great Britain and Ireland claim historic win in Walker Cup thriller
articles.summary: Great Britain and Ireland won the Walker Cup for the first time since 2015 after a nerve-shredding late comeback saw them beat the USA by a 13½-12½ scoreline.
body: Dean Robertson's side looked to be heading for defeat after suffering a clean sweep of defeats in the Sunday morning foursomes and with the Americans three points ahead going into the singles matches.
But the home side lost only two of the 10 matches and the competition eventually came down to the very last as Josh Hill won the 18th hole of his match with Tyler Watts to seal an incredible victory.
The USA will be left to regret the late turnaround after four missed putts to retain the Walker Cup.

Team GB&I needed a quick start to produce any sort of comeback and they delivered after Stuart Grehan, Luke Poulter - son of former Ryder Cup star Ian - Jack Whaley and Tyler Weaver all won their matches.

articles.title: No blockbuster signing but Arsenal's attack still finding another level
articles.summary: Midway through the second half at the Emirates Stadium, Martin Odegaard picked up the ball in an inside-right position and threaded a pass towards Kai Havertz, whose flick allowed the onrushing Bukayo Saka to test Emiliano Martinez.
body: The Chelsea goalkeeper managed to push his effort around the post. But the slick passage of play was one of many examples of how the champions, on maximum points after a third straight win, are feeling the benefits of having the trio available again.

Much of the focus ahead of the game had fallen on Chelsea's front three. How would Arsenal contain Joao Pedro, Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer? It seemed the script had been written when Rogers stunned the ground into silence after 77 seconds.

But Arsenal regained their poise and proved a point about their own attack. Rogers was one of three high-profile forwards to elude them during the summer along with Vinicius Junior and Julian Alvarez. But they may still have the tools to level up without them.

The key is simply to get their best attackers on the pitch, something injuries prevented for much of the last two seasons. This was the first time since December 2024 that Odegaard, Havertz and Saka have started a third straight league game together.
